description.zh:
访问模式。取值：
- **app**：应用访问，筛选支持应用访问的应用。
- **browser**：浏览器访问，筛选支持浏览器访问的应用。
description.en:
The access mode. Valid values:
- **app**: application access. Filters applications that support application access.
- **browser**: browser access. Filters applications that support browser access.

description.zh: 内网访问应用地址。长度为1~128个字符，支持IPv4地址、CIDR、域名、泛域名。
description.en: The address of the internal-facing access application. The address is 1 to 128 characters in length and supports IPv4 addresses, CIDR blocks, domain names, and wildcard domain names.

description.zh: 内网访问应用ID集合。最多可输入100个内网访问应用ID。
description.en: The IDs of internal-facing access applications. You can specify up to 100 application IDs.
The connector ID. You can obtain the ID from the [ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~) operation.

description.zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000。
description.en: The page number of the current page displayed in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

description.zh: 内网访问应用名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the internal-facing access application. The name is 1 to 128 characters in length, supports Chinese and uppercase and lowercase letters, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

description.zh:
内网访问策略ID。取值来源：
- [ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~)：批量查询内网访问策略。
- [CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~)：创建内网访问策略。
description.en:
The ID of the internal-facing access policy. You can obtain the ID from the following operations:
- [ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~): queries internal-facing access policies in batches.
- [CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~): creates an internal-facing access policy.

description.zh:
内网访问应用状态。取值：
- **Enabled**：开启。
- **Disabled**：关闭。
description.en:
The status of the internal-facing access application. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: enabled.
- **Disabled**: disabled.

description.zh:
内网访问标签ID。取值来源：
- [ListPrivateAccessTags](~~ListPrivateAccessTags~~)：批量查询内网访问标签。
- [CreatePrivateAccessTag](~~CreatePrivateAccessTag~~)：创建内网访问标签。
description.en:
The ID of the internal-facing access tag. You can obtain the ID from the following operations:
- [ListPrivateAccessTags](~~ListPrivateAccessTags~~): queries internal-facing access tags in batches.
- [CreatePrivateAccessTag](~~CreatePrivateAccessTag~~): creates an internal-facing access tag.

title.zh: 批量查询内网访问应用
title.en: Query internal-facing access applications in batches

example.unifiedCli: aliyun csas list-private-access-applications --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --name private_access_application_name --status Enabled --address 192.168.0.0/16 --application-ids pa-application-e12860ef6c480000 --tag-id tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000 --policy-id pa-policy-54a7838a48bf0000 --connector-id connector-94db94e06b980000 --access-modes app --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun csas ListPrivateAccessApplications --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enabled --PageSize 10 --Address '192.168.0.0/16' --CurrentPage 1 --TagId 'tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000' --ApplicationIds.1 'pa-application-e12860ef6c480000' --AccessModes app --PolicyId 'pa-policy-54a7838a48bf0000' --Name private_access_application_name --ConnectorId 'connector-94db94e06b980000' --method POST --force
